'''Ullesin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] while a [[Battle of Ilum|battle]] that took place there. During the battle, Ullesin sold equipment from a stall in the [[Republic base camp]]. While at the stall, he wore a [[Color/Legends|brown]] and purple [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] including a helmet, and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. Ullesin had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ullesin appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an end-game gear vendor for Republic players on Ilum, though his actual title varied throughout his time in the game.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Ullesin was removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
